newsitem.title: POLAND: IB AUSTRIA SEES JUTRZENKA '97 NET HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: IB AUSTRIA SEES JUTRZENKA '97 NET HIGHER.

text.p: Higher productivity and proceeds from a recent share issue should help Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA lift 1997 net profit 39 percent to 14.9 million zlotys, IB Austria Securities in Warsaw said in a report.

IB Austria said Jutrzenka's 1998 net profit should rise 29.4 percent to 19.3 million zlotys while sales would rise to 174.4 million zlotys in 1997 and 247.9 million zlotys in 1998 from 127.9 million in 1996.
"After gaining 60 million zlotys from its latest share issue Jutrzenka has prepared itself for further dynamic development," the report dated July 4 said.
"Growth in productivity along with a strengthening of marketing efforts should encourage the expansion of the firm on the market," it added.
IB Austria said the firm's possible takeover of the Gryf confectioner could also help it boost sales.
It said Jutrzenka's price-earnings ratio should rise to 14.8 this year and fall to 12.6 in 1998 from 11.7 in 1996.
